decisions.statement: A sibling is named in the addon's own manifest.
A sibling's manifest is carried by the page of the addon that ships the sibling.
A sibling has a manifest and nothing more.
A sibling name becomes a path that is removed and made again.
A sibling name is checked against a safe folder pattern before becoming a path.
The safe folder pattern is answered on its own, for a caller naming no sibling.
An addon with no readable manifest ships no sibling.
A sibling manifest a page does not carry ships no sibling.
No file name ending is spelled here.

definition: the extra addon folders one addon ships alongside its own
